final_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide cover illustration for a Chinese technology blog article. Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration summarizing an AI engineering skills map. Theme: reliable AI applications are built by connecting model knowledge, data context, agent workflows, evaluation, production operation, and machine learning foundations. The reader should quickly feel that engineering reliability comes from a continuous feedback loop around uncertain AI components. Summary angle: the core of AI engineering is connecting models, data, agents, evaluation, and production into an iterative engineering loop, not mastering one model in isolation. Narrative flow: layered reveal. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and four supporting narrative beats, each grounded in the article: a glowing model core with concise token and context symbols labeled 模型基础; clean document and structured-data streams feeding the core labeled 数据上下文; a few explicit tool paths extending from the core labeled Agent 工作流; an evaluation ring and production observation loop returning feedback to the system labeled 评测生产. Main metaphor: a luminous engineering map that unfolds from one AI system into data, tools, evaluation, and production feedback. Subject: one abstract AI application system made of a model core, data entry, tool actions, and a feedback loop, actively processing uncertain output and correcting its next action. Composition/framing: centered dominant subject with four clear paths spreading horizontally, readable wide layout, generous negative space, one focal point. Style/medium: conceptual editorial illustration combined with children's fairy-tale illustration, simple magical forms, friendly proportions, bright storybook palette, safe wonder; polished, editorial, readable, no imitation of a specific brand, studio, or living artist. Color palette: warm yellow, teal green, coral orange, deep blue-gray. Visible text policy: allow only the four short Chinese labels 模型基础, 数据上下文, Agent 工作流, 评测生产, each as a small readable label; no poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names. Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter. Avoid code rain, generic standing robots, neon purple-blue lighting, dense HUD overlays, and a multi-panel poster layout.
